meta.homeDescription: Turn long URLs into short links and QR codes you can share anywhere, and see how each one performs.
meta.featuresDescription: Short links, QR codes, click analytics, custom aliases and expiring links, all in one place.
meta.loginDescription: Log in to manage your short links and QR codes.
meta.registerDescription: Create an account to save your short links, download QR codes and track clicks.

home.subtitle: Paste any URL and get a short link and a QR code in a second. Sign in to keep them, edit them and see who clicks.

form.label: Long URL
form.placeholder: Paste a long link, e.g. example.com/blog/a-very-long-post
form.anonymousCta: Create an account to edit it and see its clicks.

paste.title: Paste
paste.text: Drop in any web address. Pick your own ending like /spring-26 if you want one.

share.title: Share
share.text: Copy the short link or download its QR code for print, slides and packaging.

measure.title: Measure
measure.text: See clicks per day, unique visitors, referrers, browsers and devices.

features.title: Everything a link needs
features.subtitle: Shorten, share and measure your links from one place. No clutter, no learning curve.

shorten.title: Short links in one step
shorten.text: Paste any URL and get a clean short link you can share in messages, posts and emails.

qr.title: A QR code for every link
qr.text: Each short link comes with a QR code you can download for print, packaging or slides.

analytics.title: Click analytics
analytics.text: See clicks over time, unique visitors, where clicks come from and which browsers and devices people use.

alias.title: Custom aliases
alias.text: Pick a memorable ending like /spring-26 instead of a random code.

expiry.title: Expiring links
expiry.text: Set an end date for campaigns and limited-time offers. The link stops working when it ends.

manage.title: All your links in one place
manage.text: Edit, update or delete your links from your account whenever you need to.

cta.title: Ready to shorten your first link?
cta.text: It takes a few seconds and you get a QR code with it.

auth.usernameHint: 3–50 letters, numbers, dots, dashes or underscores.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Log in to manage your links and QR codes.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Save your links, download QR codes and see how they perform.

auth.asideTitle: One place for every link you share.

perks.save: Every link you shorten is saved to your account
perks.qr: A QR code for each link, ready to download
perks.stats: Clicks per day, referrers, browsers and devices

links.title: My links
links.emptyText: Shorten your first link and it will show up here.
links.expiresHint: The link stops working after this time
links.expiresEditHint: Leave empty for a link that never expires
links.deleteText: {link} will stop working and its click history will be deleted. This can't be undone.
links.subtitle: Everything you have shortened, with its clicks.

analytics.botsExcluded: {count} clicks from bots and link previews are not counted.

errors.passwordLength: Password must be at least 8 characters

errors.unavailable: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment.
errors.notFoundText: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has moved.
errors.unexpectedText: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
errors.urlInvalid: Enter a valid link, like https://example.com

errors.expiryPast: Pick a time in the future
